salesHistory.editHint: Adjust unit prices, quantities and discounts, or put a product the invoice never carried onto it. The quantity is what the customer LEAVES WITH: bring a line down and the units that come back are added to the receipt as their own − line, at a price deducted from the total — the sold line is never rubbed out, so a fully returned invoice still lists every product. Inventory and totals recalculate automatically, and a line the shelf cannot give is refused before anything is written.

salesHistory.editSurplusNote: This cannot be saved — the receipt would leave the shop owing the customer. Bring the lines level, or void the sale and ring the exchange at the counter.
